_comment: Registered implementations. Each entry's `cmd` is the executable the checker
drives through the contract in spec/cli.md.
Placeholders: {python} becomes the interpreter running the checker, {repo}
the repository root, and {ports_root} the directory of an external ports.json
`python` is the REFERENCE: grading it against its own goldens must report
exactly zero differences, which is how the harness proves it can pass.
The Go, .NET 8 and Kotlin/JVM ports live in https://github.com/protei300/RussianDocsOCR-ports
and carry their own ports.json driven with --ports-file.
